text.p: TimberWest Timber Trust said on Tuesday it authorised a distribution of $0.325 per trust unit payable on October 15 to holders of Trust Units of record on September 30, 1997.
This is the first regular distribution to be made by the Trust.
TimberWest said in a news release that the funds to make the distribution are to be paid to the trust by its wholly owned subsidiary, TimberWest Forest Holdings Ltd, on September 30.

The news release said the distribution will be made up of about $0.259 of interest payable on the notes issued to the Trust by TimberWest Forest Holdings, and $0.066 as dividends declared by TimberWest Forest Holdings upon the shares held by the trust.

Keith Purchase, a trustee and the chief executive of TimberWest Forest Holdings, said that, on the basis of the cash flows of TimberWest, he expects the distributions per trust unit will remain consistent at this level.
